title: Attractive bamboo Ziplock bag organizer but for a drawer only & labeling is off
text:
Attractive bamboo Ziplock bag organizer but for a drawer only & labeling is off. This is a really nice four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. However, the QUART label is in a smaller font than the other labels and the GALLON label should really be centered.

This is for use in a drawer only as there are no hanging holes. Four rubberized circles are provided to keep this from moving around in a drawer. I just affixed them to the four corners on the back.

Overall, this is a functional organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in the cabinets. It is definitely an attractive unit as long as I do not look at the labels. The varied sized and varied placement of the labeling as well as the lack of hanging holes, caused me to rate this 3 stars. The current price of $29 ($32 minus $3) is on the high side of competitively priced. Other options for products like this that are available are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For those looking to store foil and plastic wrap with their bags, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.
